name: The Kitchen Guys LLC
old_description: Commercial Kitchen Equipment and Design Firm based in New Orleans, Louisana.
about:
The Kitchen Guys LLC is headquartered in Slidell, Louisiana, and traces its roots to 1955 when Hoyt Refrigeration Co. began manufacturing and installing convenience-store and supermarket equipment in Lecompte, Louisiana. After several relocations and ownership changes — including Sherman Roberts’ 1969 founding of Roberts Refrigeration and the Bennett family’s purchase in 1986 — the business was rebranded as The Kitchen Guys in 2022 when third-generation owner Dustin Bennett acquired the company. The firm remains family-owned and operates from its Slidell base while serving clients nationwide.

The company provides end-to-end commercial kitchen services: consulting and design, equipment procurement through two major buying groups, project coordination and logistics, custom equipment specification with shop drawings, installation using local and national crews, and ongoing service and leasing (including dishmachine leasing). They handle projects ranging from single-equipment replacements to large-scale stadium and hotel kitchens, and they produce rough-in coordination drawings for general contractors.

Their customer base spans restaurants, hotels, schools, stadiums, supermarkets, convenience stores, and multi-unit chain concepts across the continental United States. The team includes professionals who have worked inside restaurants, not just designed for them, which informs their practical approach to workflow and code compliance.

The Kitchen Guys differentiate themselves through unlimited design revisions until the client approves the final layout, a core-values framework they call “The Kitchen Guys’ Way” (committed, persistent, innovative, fun), and a promise to manage all logistics and storage in sync with construction schedules so that damaged or delayed items are communicated immediately.
